k1uauo:247: Composite reward architecture is a key design decision for production-grade RFT systems. AWS recommends never relying solely on an LLM judge; instead, combine deterministic components (format validation, length penalties, language consistency, safety filtering) with an LLM judge. This "fast-slow separation" strategy can immediately intercept cheap failures such as format errors, avoiding expensive LLM calls for clearly invalid outputs, while preserving deep semantic quality assessment.
